fusions.name: Final Run
fusions.desc: Springs at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 16 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Snarling Rush
fusions.desc: Lunges through a cone 3 tiles long for 4 damage, each target with a 30% chance to be [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing the Gap
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Smell of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 15% more damage.
